## Frequently asked questions

Do you only have these connectors?
![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg)


We have the industry's largest library of connectors, and it's always growing! We often add new data connectors, and we build custom connectors for our Business and Enterprise customers who have a special request.

If you're on our free or starter plan, we can often find ways to bring your data into Funnel without a connector – such as a CSV file or spreadsheet, or creating a webhook. Just [get in touch](https://funnel.io/contact) and we can tell you more.



What's the difference between custom and core connectors?
![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg)


Core connectors are the ones we include as standard across all our plans. Custom connectors are built especially on request, and are only available on the higher-tier plans. Core connectors tend to be the ones that we see most people using, while custom connectors are usually more specialist or less widely used.



If I need a custom-made connector, how long does it take?
![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg)

We'll pick up your custom request within two working days, and new connectors usually take between two to eight weeks from then, depending on the complexity.

Can I get a free trial?
![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg)


We'll be happy to set you up with a free trial, tailored to your exact requirements. But please note that we can't make custom connectors for your free trial.
